evals.prompt: The Taste Brief for Wax & Wane is measured. Build the landing page from it.
evals.expected_output: Save the reading, the Design DNA and the production plan with design_validate, fetch only the planned fonts, build in the project's design system, check, capture and review.
expectations: Saves a reading of 2-4 clusters, citing entries by the names the brief lists and naming 1-3 visual conventions per cluster, before the DNA
Saves a DNA whose palette and typography devices anchor to quality entries, with the palette or typography device naming one of the reading's conventions
Saves a production plan with one step per device and 2-6 review criteria
Fetches only the fonts the plan uses with materials fetch
Declares each palette colour and font in a CSS custom property used through var()
Calls design_check, repairs missing devices and keeps at most two default-look signatures before design_capture
Judges every review criterion on a capture of the same round with design_validate stage review, with a critique of three generic choices and a fan's verdict

evals.prompt: Restyle this game's character screen from the measured Taste Brief. The game is a Godot project with no HTML pages.
evals.expected_output: Use the generic medium: declare tokens as the source writes them, and review on the specimen board.
expectations: Declares colours as they appear in the source, such as 0xFF3E5C6B or a hex string
Declares motion values in literals when they live in code
Captures the specimen board with design_capture specimen true for the review
